description.text: The ninth expansion of the Scarlet & Violet series, released on 24 January 2025, which brought back Trainer's Pokémon, here those of N, Lillie, Hop and Iono. A Trainer's Pokémon evolves from a Pokémon with the same Trainer's name, so each Trainer's cards build a deck together: N's Zoroark ex, Lillie's Clefairy ex, Hop's Zacian ex and Iono's Bellibolt ex lead it, with Trainer cards for each, such as N's Castle, N's PP Up, Lillie's Pearl, Hop's Bag and the Stadium Postwick. Volcanion ex, Salamence ex, Mamoswine ex and Dudunsparce ex join them, with the Supporters Iris's Fighting Spirit and Brock's Scouting. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 100, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and Ultra Rare Iono's Bellibolt ex, N's Zoroark ex and Spiky Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Journey Together in March 2025.
